description: This is a Java test source file for the IpTrackingFilter component in the Apache Fineract project. It contains unit tests verifying the behavior of IP address extraction and setting in the filter, covering scenarios with different headers and configuration settings.

classes.name: IpTrackingFilterTest
classes.description: A JUnit 5 test class for testing the IP tracking filter logic in the Apache Fineract project.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the test environment before each test, configuring the FineractProperties and the filter under test.

methods.name: testGetClientIp_UsesCorrectHeaderEnabled
methods.description: Tests that the filter correctly sets the client IP attribute from request headers when IP tracking is enabled.

methods.name: testGetClientIpAddress_UsesCorrectHeaderDisabled
methods.description: Verifies that when IP tracking is disabled, the filter does not set the IP attribute from request headers.

methods.name: testGetClientIpAddress_UsesCorrectHeaderIpAdressUtilsEnable
methods.description: Ensures that when enabled, the filter uses IpAddressUtils.getClientIp() to set the IP attribute.

methods.name: testGetClientIpAddress_UsesCorrectHeaderIpAdressUtilsDisabled
methods.description: Ensures that when disabled, the filter does not invoke IpAddressUtils.getClientIp().
